discord.text:
**Newsroom brief: State Department Approves Possible APKWS II Sale to Italy**

Italy’s request covers 5,031 guidance sections, but the document’s most important qualifier is procedural: the $364 million figure belongs to a possible sale.

**Context:** The record says the State Department approved a possible Foreign Military Sale to the Government of Italy for Guidance Section Single Variant Air-to-Air Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System-II and related equipment.

Source-bound brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/state-department-approves-possible-apkws-ii-sale-to-italy
